kicker: AI isn’t one machine — it’s a whole tree with many branches.
summary: AI is a tree with many branches; chatbots are just one small twig.

quiz.q: Your next TikTok video always seems oddly perfect for you. Which branch picks it?
quiz.explain: That’s recommendation AI: it doesn’t make new videos, it picks from existing ones the video you’re most likely to keep watching.

seed.label: Plant a seed
seed.art: Ink painting: a shallow bonsai pot, a seed resting on the soil, raked sand below, a pale sun behind.
seed.insight: Most AI you meet every day grows from one root: machine learning — computers drawing patterns from many examples.
seed.detail: Unlike regular software, no one writes each rule by hand, so it guesses very well but is sometimes wrong.

branches.label: The branches
branches.art: Ink painting: a bonsai with four leafy crowns, each one a family of AI; tap a crown and an ink-drawn fruit hangs down: a persimmon with an eye, a bunch of berries with one ripe red, a small robot arm picking fruit. The top crown is generative AI: a young apricot-blossom branch grows six flowers, and tapping each one makes the brush paint a small picture.
branches.twigAria: {name} flower on the young generative AI branch — see explanation

families.name: Recognition / classification AI
families.insight: Recognition AI looks, listens, then files things in the right box — like unlocking your phone with your face, or filtering spam.
families.detail: It creates nothing new; it just answers: what is this, who is it, what kind is it.

insight.text: Recommendation AI guesses what you’ll probably like next — like your next TikTok video, or a product on Shopee.

detail.text: TikTok says it picks videos based on what you like, share, comment on and watch to the end.

families.name: Generative AI
families.insight: Generative AI makes something new: type a description, get back text or an image that never existed before.
families.detail: The chatbot you use is just one twig on this branch, alongside images, video, audio, 3D and code.

families.name: Robots / physical AI
families.insight: Robots are AI with a body: they see through cameras, move around, grab things — like a robot vacuum dodging chair legs.
families.detail: Robot arms in warehouses do the same: recognize an item, then grab it in the right place.

twigs.name: Text (LLM)
twigs.insight: An LLM — large language model — reads huge amounts of text to learn how to keep writing, one small piece at a time.

detail.text: ChatGPT, a chatbot on this branch, launched on November 30, 2022.

twigs.name: Images
twigs.insight: Turns a description into a brand-new image, or edits part of an existing one.
twigs.detail: Example: type “a cat in a conical hat by a lotus pond” and get back an image that never existed.

twigs.name: Video
twigs.insight: Makes a short video clip from a description, or from a single photo.
twigs.detail: Example: turn a product photo into a short ad clip.

twigs.name: Sound, music, voice
twigs.insight: Reads text aloud in a natural voice, composes music, or makes sound effects for video.
twigs.detail: Example: turn an article into a read-aloud that sounds like a podcast.

twigs.name: 3D models
twigs.insight: Creates 3D objects you can spin to see from every side, from a description or a photo.
twigs.detail: Example: from a photo of a chair, make a 3D model to try out in a virtual room.

twigs.name: Code (programming)
twigs.insight: Writes and fixes code — the lines of instructions behind software, apps and websites.
twigs.detail: Example: describe an event sign-up page in words, and AI writes the code for you.
